description: This PHP class file defines a migration script for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.2.0. It contains methods to modify database schema, insert permissions, configure UI components, and manage localization strings during the upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for performing database schema and data updates during the system upgrade to version 5.2.0 for OrangeHRM. It handles schema alterations, data migrations, configuration updates, and localization management.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database and system modifications necessary for upgrading to version 5.2.0, including schema changes, data updates, and configuration resets.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper, used for managing language string groups and entries.

methods.name: updatePimLeftMenuConfigurators
methods.description: Updates the menu configurators for the PIM module in the left menu.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Aligns the organization subunit name with the general organization info name.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the homepage URL for specific user roles.

methods.name: insertLDAPMenuItem
methods.description: Inserts an LDAP configuration menu item into the main menu hierarchy.

methods.name: cleanLDAPAddonData
methods.description: Removes LDAP-related data groups, screens, and modules from the system for clean upgrade.

methods.name: insertLangStringNotes
methods.description: Loads and updates localization note strings from a YAML file.

methods.name: cleanI18nGroups
methods.description: Cleans and reassigns internationalization groups and strings during migration.
